description: Lazy senior dev mode: forces the simplest, shortest solution that works (YAGNI, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions). Ships skills ponytail, ponytail-review, ponytail-audit, ponytail-debt, ponytail-gain, ponytail-help plus hooks and a status line.

install.claude_code: /plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail, then /plugin install ponytail@ponytail
install.other_agents: See README: Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini, Kiro, Windsurf, Cline, OpenClaw and Hermes adapters are included in the repo.

name: ponytail
